title: PersonaCUABench: Benchmarking Computer-Use Agents Serving Diverse Personas
abstract: arXiv:2610.22990v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Computer-use agents (CUAs) are commonly evaluated against fixed task specifications, but users may omit requirements, add constraints, or require approval before consequential actions. Completing the benchmark instruction does not guarantee serving the person who asked. We introduce PersonaCUABench, which holds 74 tasks across 11 domains fixed and varies only who asks. A persona agent, playing one of 44 personas in four groups, rewrites each instruction in that user's own words and answers the CUA's questions, while the CUA sees only the dialogue, never the profile or the original instruction. Across nine backbones (3,330 runs), mean task completion falls by 36% relative to the original requests. The losses have two sources: in 59.9% of cells that lose points, the agent engages with what the user asked for and still gets it wrong, and 11.2% are stops the user requested that the checker scores as failures. translated_title: PersonaCUABench：面向多样化用户角色的计算机使用智能体基准测试
translated_abstract: 计算机使用智能体（CUA）通常根据固定的任务规范进行评估，但用户可能会遗漏需求、添加约束条件，或要求在执行有重大影响的操作前先获得批准。完成基准测试指令并不保证能服务好提出请求的那个人。我们提出了 PersonaCUABench，该基准将跨 11 个领域的 74 个任务保持固定，仅改变“谁在提问”。一个角色智能体扮演四组共 44 个用户角色之一，用该用户自己的措辞重写每条指令并回答 CUA 的提问，而 CUA 只能看到对话内容，永远看不到用户画像或原始指令。在九个骨干模型上的实验（共 3,330 次运行）显示，相对于原始请求，平均任务完成率下降了 36%。这些损失有两个来源：在丢失分数的案例中，59.9% 的情况下智能体确实响应了用户的要求但仍然做错了；11.2% 是用户主动要求的停止操作，却被评分器判定为失败。即使当某个角色请求……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出 PersonaCUABench 基准，通过让 44 种不同用户角色用自己的措辞重写固定的任务指令，仅改变“谁在提问”就使九个骨干模型的平均任务完成率下降 36%，揭示了现有计算机使用智能体难以真正服务不同用户的个性化需求。
en_tdlr: PersonaCUABench benchmarks computer-use agents by holding 74 fixed tasks constant and varying only who asks through 44 diverse personas, revealing a 36% drop in mean task completion across nine backbones and exposing that agents fail to serve the actual person behind the request.
